column1: # The verb group of a wished-for clause (the past that does not hold): the
# subjunctive form that stands in for the plain past of a verb or modal.
# key     `be` (the copula, simple past) or a modal's present form. A `be` row
#         is the whole verb group; a modal row is followed by the bare verb.
# Linguistic source: Murphy Units 40-41. After `wish`, `be` is `were` for every
# person ("i wish she were here", not "was"), and `must` is said `had to`
# ("i wish we did not have to go").
